item.title: How to Clean Up Zombie Processes
item.description: 1. What a Zombie Process Is How a process is created: The parent process calls fork() to create a child process The child process calls exec() to load a new program The child process finishes executing and calls exit() or returns The parent process calls wait() or waitpid() If the parent process never calls wait() or waitpid(), the child stays in the system after it finishes, becoming a zombie process.
